title: Ye The Bain Banu ke Shame Garibaan
body:
Ali Asghar a.s
<<MINI>>
Ye the bain bano ke shame gharibaan -2
Kahaan kho gaye ho mere pyare Asghar
Kaheen dar na jana is aafat ke ban mein-2
Kahan ja chhupe ho mere pyare Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Main kyunkar tumhe dhoondun andhiyari shab mein
<<MINI>>
Kahan so rahe ho mere pyare Asghar
Ye the bain bano ke shame gharibaan-2
<<DIVIDER>>
Suna hai koi hurmula tha sitamgar
Chalaya tha teere sitam jisne sheh par
Humak kar liya tumne apne gale par
Bahut khush hai iss par tumhari ye maadar
Mujhe surkhuru peshe binte payamabar
Tumheen kar gaye ho mere pyare Asghar
<<MINI>>
Ye the bain bano ke shame gharibaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Gila to nahi hai tumhe apni maan se
Tumhe paani pene ko bheja tha maine
Tum aa bhi gaye to sambhalungi kaise
Suna hai rasan basta jana hai yaan se
Na majbur hoti to jaane na deti
Sabhi jaante ho mere pyare Asghar
<<MINI>>
Ye the bain bano ke shame gharibaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Tumhe sheh ne paani pilaya to hoga
Tumhe paas apne sulayenge baba
Tum ab apne baba ke seene pa sona
Na koi zid apne baba se karna
Na hoga sitam koi iss se ziyada
Jo tum seh chuke ho mere pyare Asghar
<<MINI>>
Ye the bain bano ke shame gharibaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhe sham-o-Kufa bhi jana hai beta
Isi Karbala tak tha saath apna beta
Isi ko ab apna muqaddar samjhna
Mere paas soyegi bali Sakina
Qayamat talak ab waheen sote rehna
<<MINI>>
Jahan so rahe ho mere pyare Asghar
Ye the bain bano ke shaame gharibaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Waheen ban mein auno mohammad bhi honge
Yaqinan yatimaane muslim bhi honge
Tumhari tasalli ko Qasim bhi honge
Tumhe denge abbaso Akbar dilase
Yahan mard sirf ik hain sajjad-e-muztar
Jo tum dekhte ho mere pyare Asghar
<<MINI>>
Ye the bain bano ke shame gharibaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jalaya laeeno ne khaimon ko aisa
Na jhula tera main bacha paee beta
Tadapti hai khaime me bali Sakina
Wahan muntazir hai madine me sughra
Kisi ki khabar kuch nahi tum ko beta
<<MINI>>
Kahaan ja base ho mere pyare Asghar
Ye the bain bano ke shame gharibaan
Kahan kho gaye ho mere pyare Asghar
Kaheen dar na jana is aafat ke ban mein
Kahan ja chhupe ho mere pyare Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Main kyonkar tumhe dhoondun andhiyari shab mein
<<MINI>>
Kahan so rahe ho mere pyare Asghar
Ye the bain bano ke shame gharibaan
author: Sibte Jaffer Shaheed
